v3-24.candidate: and he went out. The king’s attendants entered and looked, and behold, the upper-room doors were closed. They said, “Perhaps he is sitting on the privy in the bedroom’s retreat?”

v3-25.candidate: They waited in embarrassment, and behold, no one opened the upper-room doors. They took the key and opened them, and there was their lord, fallen dead on the ground.
